name: tokengotchi
description: Clawd, the Claude Code mascot, in a pixel office pane: it types on a laptop while Claude works, levels up from your tokens, collects items when work is done, and shows your 5-hour limit as energy

name.title: Pet name
name.description: What your pet is called when it first hatches (rename it later with /pet rename)

openOnStart.title: Open the pane on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pet's pane when a session starts (it only docks on wide terminals; /pet opens it any time)

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the pet's name, level and whether it's working under the prompt

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Pop up a toast when the pet finds an item or levels up
